mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, r.name AS restaurantName, r.logo_url AS restaurantLogo, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status AS status, o.created_time AS createdTime FROM orders o JOIN restaurant r ON o.restaurant_id = r.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND ( r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.dish_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY o.created_time DESC
